authored_assumptions: This is a new authored 3D interpretation of the existing original fox design, not recovered geometry or a neural text-to-3D result.
Complete hidden surfaces and twenty-bone rest layout are authored; the original fox left/right bone names are preserved as identifiers.
The continuous arm and leg lofts use explicit multi-bone skin blends around elbows and knees; they are not muscle or cloth simulations.
The shoulder roots are rounded and buried within the torso, with torso/arm weight blending; skin is not a single watertight anatomical retopology.
The scarf, eyelids, fingers and face are sculpted fixed geometry without independent expressions or cloth dynamics.
The book drawings and pencil strokes remain authored gestures: no new ink or page simulation is claimed.
This PBR browser-quality variant is separate from Weft's restricted diffuse-only importer profile.
The preserved four skeletal actions are authored animation, not learned behavior or Weft physics.
Browser GLB fur is 5,000 authored six-vertex alpha-masked hair ribbons; the 55,000-fiber upper-bound native Blender groom is a separate render/edit representation and is not exported as GLB strands.
Both fur representations retain the old configured lengths and inherited surface skinning; no strand dynamics, measured fur, recovered groom, or Muse-level visual parity is claimed.
The fox iris remains its original glossy colored geometry: a radial iris map is not applied to an incompatible latitude/longitude UV sphere.

HD textures are seeded, locally authored procedural patterns at native1024/2048 resolution, not neural output, reference-extracted texture maps or evidence of photorealism. Studio floor and exposure are render settings, not simulation geometry.

hd_upgrade.edit_prompt: Preserve this character/object's exact base mesh components, proportions, palettes, accessories, bone rests and four skeletal actions. Add native-resolution 1024/2048 procedural basecolor and tangent-normal textures with irregular fine surface detail, not an enlarged 512px bitmap. Use a grounded soft studio with world strength0.3 and exposure0.55. Do not claim exact Muse reconstruction or equal visual quality before rendering and comparison. Keep all sources and all prior recipes unchanged. Replace sparse opaque triangle fur with two explicitly different deliverable representations: 5,000 six-vertex alpha-masked GLB hair ribbons and a native Blender groom with 5,000 parents and ten children per parent (55,000 configured fibers maximum). Keep prior fur lengths, use ribbon width0.022m, native hair radius0.00025m and roughness0.001m. Groom/card roots inherit the existing skin and preserve props. Keep hair static relative to its deforming surface; no hair dynamics or reconstructed real anatomy.
hd_upgrade.exact_user_request: you're working on making these avatars better right? I want the same textures and hd quality as the muse ones for example fura and hari
hd_upgrade.prior_source_prompt: Create an editable, controllable full-body stylized red fox craftsperson. Preserve the red-orange coat, cream muzzle/chest/tail tip, dark sock paws, oversized triangular ears, sea-green scarf, navy sketchbook, golden pencil and curled sweeping tail in every state. Author unseen surfaces consistently; this is an original toy-like 3D design, not a recovered scan. Idle should breathe and listen, making_something should sketch with repeated short pencil strokes, working should read the sketchbook with a slow gaze scan, and milestone_level_up should lift both tools and hop once. Keep the camera fixed and the whole body visible. Revision: keep the existing palette, face, proportions and camera. Close elbow and knee gaps with small smooth joints. For milestone_level_up, raise the shoulders and bend both forearms until paws and held tools are above shoulder height; include one gentle upward hop. Keep book facing the viewer at the peak. Further working-state refinement: visibly lift the book toward the face with the left arm, lower the gaze and scan the raised page. Keep the right pencil hand resting so reading and sketching are clearly different actions.

glb.skeletal_clips: All four original clips preserved unchanged

hd_upgrade.source_prompt: Refine the existing orange-and-cream fox craftsperson into a premium, expressive, fully modeled storybook character. Preserve the teal scarf, navy sketchbook, gold pencil, twenty named joints and the four authored actions. Replace ball-separated arms and knees with continuous weighted skin; shape a broad-cheeked tapered face, cupped pointed ears, curved fluffy tail, glossy amber eyes with sclera, eyelids and small catchlights, a soft triangular nose and a subtle smile. Add short geometric fur and embedded procedural fur textures, cloth folds and scarf fringes, a bound book with page edges, elastic strap and cover emblem, and a real wood/graphite pencil tip. Use physically based opaque surfaces; preserve every visible detail in the animated GLB, not just the portrait. Author the back, underside, topology and skin weights explicitly; do not claim recovered anatomy or fur simulation. Refinement after v3 review: bury rounded shoulder roots inside the torso, blend shoulder weights to the torso, smooth the complete elbow centerline and head cross sections, and replace twin rounded cheek lobes with a single tapered fox muzzle. Retain the denser 12,700-strand fur pass and all four action meanings.

studio_grounding.method: Conservative authored rest bounds of named contact parts, including configured maximum fur length; not simulated ground contact
